aspect_scaling.post_original_formula: new_fov = 2 * degrees(atan(tan(radians(current_fov)/2) * target_aspect/current_aspect)); write new_fov and target_aspect together
aspect_scaling.zero_aspect: Resolve normal aspect from viewport width/height; do not write zero as active target.
aspect_scaling.flags: Normal scaling block skipped when view+0x555 bit0x02 is set; do not infer equivalence for that alternate case.

matrix_followup.first_builder: Reads view origin/angles/FOV/aspect into output matrices; no direct stores to source view found.

matrix_followup.later_render_limit: Static call path supports post-original override before matrices. Actual render cadence and any later engine intervention remain runtime validation items.

engine.validated_by: PE disassembly and native demo_pause/demo_resume/demo_timescale/demo_info callbacks; no runtime execution
notes: Demo player vtable 0x535730 is primary IDemoPlayer with COL offset 0; no this adjustment.
NetworkService current tick minus player+0x1fc yields demo-relative tick.
r_aspectratio positive value overrides width/height; no mutation performed by getter.

At the render hook, use fractional current_time; demoTick alone is intentionally quantized. Initial path time can be anchored to the paused frame before demo_resume; runtime timing probe required for exact replay-tick alignment.

Do NOT reconstruct double time using globals+0x44 and +0x38. Helper0x258b0 rounds curtime/interval+0.5 then CVTTSS2SI, so +0x44 already includes fraction rollover. It can cause a full-tick jump. Use curtime+0x30 unless original engine source tick/fraction lifetime is validated at the hook.

client_globals.evidence: engine ctor 0x8049e + SetGlobals call 0x80d5b. ClientFrameSimulate 0x6c66b-0x6c6ab computes (integerTick+fraction)*interval; helper0x631f0 writes globals+0x30. Render-time dynamics must still be validated live.
client_globals.context_tick_semantics: nearest integer from already float-quantized curtime/interval +0.5; NOT the base tick to pair with fraction+0x38
